title.narrative: Humanitarian Project to support 184 families affected by the tropical storm # 12 in EL Salvador

description.narrative:
The tropical storm 12 E affected the 95% of the country especially the people who live at the pacific cost and at the shores of the Lempa, Jibia , Rio Grande, and the Paz rivers. Most of those families are farmers who had a lot of lost of their livestock, and staple grain. According with the CEPAL the economic damage estimation is around U$ 134.5 millions. (Evaluación de daños y pérdidas en El Salvador, ocasionados por la Depresión Tropical 12E. STP-CEPAL. Octubre de 2011)
This project will be implemented in the departments of San Miguel in the pacific coast where Maiz works with the six co-op (El Manguito, Sn Juan Ucesista, Guanacastal, Gualuca, Chilanguera, La Granja (Caja de Agua) all member of the Confederation of the Agrarian Reform (CONFRAS). This proposal will be implemented with 184 famers (1004 people)who have lost their staple crops and have suffered extensive damage to their local infrastructure. The main themes prioritized are; food security through the re-planting of staple food crops (corn and beans) to produce food in the short term. This project will be implemented from January 2012-June 2012; the period that the crops need to be harvested.
Even when this region of the country suffers a lot of damage, losses of crops is too much. Maiz has just indentified to prioritize support for re-planting of 25 ha of corns and beans crops especially through provision of some inputs such as; seeds and input to produce organic fertilizer which will enable each farmer to be able to plant 0.5 ha, one of corn and one of beans. Most of the farmers will grow these crops using the moisture remaining on the soil which is a traditional practice used in this region.
The beneficiary will contribute with labour forces and some input to get good production yield, the partner will be in charge of procuring and delivery of inputs and the monitoring as well
